core_categories: Specialty Pharmaceuticals; General Pharmaceuticals; Medical Equipment; Clinical Care Supplies; Support and Maintenance Items
specialty_focus: Farmacias La Paz is a Mexican pharmacy retailer specializing in the retail distribution of high-specialty prescription drugs and essential medical equipment. It focuses on managing complex, chronic, and severe health conditions, offering hard-to-find clinical treatments, injectables, and regulated prescription portfolios. It does not specifically deal in wearable medical devices.
